notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 federate handle and name lookup services. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies NotConnected and FederateNotExecutionMember boundaries, active-member name-to-handle and handle-to-name round trips, missing-name, invalid-handle, and foreign-handle failures, post-resignation name removal, retained departed-handle identity, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador getFederateHandle and getFederateName services across membership, invalid-input, foreign-handle, and resignation boundaries
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador federate identity lookup declarations
